top_signals.title: BlackRock’s Rieder on Yield Curve, Federal Reserve Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, says the front end of the yield curve is “still very attractive,” and discusses the state of the US economy and why he is positioned for a hawkish Federal Reserve. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Thursday
top_signals.summary: We've got higher oil prices and interest rates to deal with this morning.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Turkey’s foreign minister says Ankara weighing Saudi defense support, rules out offensive role
top_signals.summary: Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, under which an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all.
